title_zh: 搬运前请求检查手推车稳定性

scenario.label_zh: 展柜搬运前的手推车检查请求
scenario.goal_zh: 说明稳定性与身体负担的担忧并约定暂停搬运等待技术人员检查

context_zh: 展馆员工 Ada 与 Leon 正准备搬动一只展柜，发现手推车晃动，尚未开始搬运。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: I’m worried about the stability of this trolley. It rocks even before we put the cabinet on it.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: I could try to stabilize it by holding the side as we move.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: That would put a lot of strain on you, and it wouldn’t tell us why it’s rocking.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: You’re right. Let’s leave the cabinet where it is and get the technician.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: I’ll call. We should wait for the trolley to be checked before moving anything.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Agreed. I won’t load it in the meantime.
